own_solution.law: Q = n * 3R * dT with n = m/M (Dulong-Petit, stated)
assumptions: constant molar heat capacity 3R as stated
added lead on the block starts at the block's temperature

notes: n = 500/207.2 = 2.41313 mol; Q = 2.41313 * 24.942 * 60 = 3611.3 J. With 0.68 kg: Q = 3611.3*0.68/0.5 = 4911.4 J. Heater power: Q = P t only fixes the heating time (not asked), so the power does not enter the answer; I label it C (it belongs to the system's energy balance but drops out); could also be argued D. Variant checks: TA290/TC49F/T6CF0/TD22B all 0.18 kg; T30A5/TBFB5 both 310 W; TAA2E/T85DA 'a small amount'.
